name: pdk-go-mysql-server-1272
instr:
Go MySQL Server is checked out at `/app`. UPDATE and DELETE statements on memory tables with multiple self-referencing foreign keys take roughly a third of a second each, even with a handful of rows and no cascading changes. Make statement execution substantially faster through `sqle.Engine.Query` while preserving query results and foreign-key behavior. The workload includes updates to existing rows and deletes of existing or absent rows on tables with two self-referencing foreign keys; aim for an order-of-magnitude improvement on these statements without making any of these workloads noticeably slower.

Keep existing exported APIs compatible. The environment is offline. The repository must build and its tests must pass with test files restored to their original versions; hidden statement workloads compare the full results with the original behavior and measure elapsed wall time against the original code. Run `go test -vet=off -count=1 ./...` from `/app` to check the tests. Changes to production Go code under `/app` are the deliverable.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /app/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete - the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front invest
